ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Programmatic systems can buy media automatically, but salespeople still decide which clients are worth developing, how to build a long-term partnership, and how to negotiate the budget.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 103,700 advertising sales agents employed in 2024, falling to a projected 97,100 by 2034. That is a net loss of roughly 6,600 jobs, with about 9,300 openings each year and a 2026 median annual wage near $61,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace advertising sales agents, but it will reduce standardized roles. Programmatic and self-service platforms accelerate routine ad inventory, shifting sales from selling placements toward client development, custom solutions, performance optimization, and long-term relationships. People limited to standard inventory face pressure, while salespeople who develop accounts and customize solutions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Customer profile recommendations
Intelligent solution generation
Budget allocation optimization
Renewal-risk alerts
ai_s2_auto: Programmatic automated media buying
Self-service advertising platform
Automated quote generation
Automated performance reports
ai_s3_list: Client management: people sustain relationships.
Solution customization: people uncover the pain points.
Negotiation and contracting: people negotiate price.
Performance optimization: people make tradeoffs.
Long-term relationships: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high AI exposure range for sales. Systems accelerate standard media buying, while people remain responsible for account development and customization.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Standard placement selling can be replaced, not client development. People who build accounts and customize solutions become scarcer as efficiency improves. Salespeople limited to standard inventory face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build data skills and sales language from the start of a communications or marketing career. Pure volume selling is shrinking in the AI era, so develop account-management ability early.
Move beyond selling placements toward solutions plus account development. Learn campaign data and work toward major accounts.
Highlight sales performance and client resources, and specify the industries you have served. Agencies value steadiness and drive.
Do not evaluate candidates on communication alone; look for business judgment. Experienced sellers who can grow major accounts deserve high commissions.

ai_s7_trends: Programmatic systems become widespread and standard roles shrink.
Major accounts and customization create opportunities.
Sales professionals with strong business judgment are in greater demand.

body: Advertising sales agents lead the sale of advertising inventory and campaign solutions, coordinating clients, budgets, and placements. They use data and proposals to win campaigns and follow through on delivery and performance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Programmatic systems can buy media automatically, but salespeople still decide which clients are worth developing, how to build a long-term partnership, and how to negotiate the budget.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 程序化能自动买量，但哪类客户值得养、怎么讲成长期合作、预算怎么谈，还是销售定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年广告销售代表在岗约 10.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.71 万人，岗位净减约 0.66 万个，年均产生约 0.93 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.15 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代广告销售，但会压缩标准岗。程序化与自助投放把常规广告位提速，销售从「卖点位」挪向「客户经营、方案定制、效果优化、长期关系」。真正被挤掉的是只卖标准资源的，有经营力能定制的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 客户画像推荐
方案智能生成
预算分配优化
续约风险预警
ai_s2_auto: 程序化自动买量
自助投放平台
报价自动生成
效果自动报表
ai_s3_list: 客户经营：关系靠人养。
方案定制：痛点靠人挖。
谈判签约：价位靠人谈。
效果优化：取舍靠人。
长期关系：信任靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的销售区——标准投放被系统加速，但经营与定制还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「卖标准点位」动作，不是「客户经营」的岗位。有经营力、能定制方案的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会卖标准资源的销售。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 传媒/市场起步多练数据和话术，AI 时代纯卖量在缩，早点练经营。
从「卖点位」升级成「做方案 + 养客户」，学投放数据，争取大客户。
突出业绩和客户资源，写清跟过哪些行业。代理看重稳和冲。
选人别只看口才，要看有没有经营脑子。能养大客户的骨干，值得给高提成。

ai_s7_trends: 程序化普及，标准岗缩。
大客户与定制带来机会。
有经营力的销售更抢手。

body: 广告销售代理主导广告资源与投放方案的销售，统筹客户、预算与点位，运用数据与提案手段，达成投放并跟进效果落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 程序化能自动买量，但哪类客户值得养、怎么讲成长期合作、预算怎么谈，还是销售定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Generative tools can produce ten visual options in seconds, but the art director still decides which one fits the brand and whether it delivers the feeling the client wants.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows that about 135,000 art directors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 140,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 5,700 jobs, with roughly 12,300 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $111,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace art directors, but it will accelerate image creation and layout. Midjourney and other layout and design tools speed up asset production and composition, shifting art directors from making everything themselves toward setting direction, judging aesthetics, leading teams, and working with clients. Routine production artists face the greatest pressure, while people with strong creative strategy skills become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Rapid exploration of creative concepts
Intelligent asset search
Preliminary quality screening of finished work
Parallel iteration of multiple versions
ai_s2_auto: Generative image creation and asset production
AI-assisted layout and composition
Style transfer and color selection
Automated sketch coloring
ai_s3_list: Creative direction: depends on people.
Aesthetic judgment: built through practice.
Client coordination: built through negotiation.
Final quality control: depends on a trained eye.
Strategic coordination: depends on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high exposure zone, where systems absorb more asset production and layout work while direction-setting and coordination still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high replacement risk. Routine production art and image-making tasks are being automated, not the role of coordinating creative work. People with a clear aesthetic point of view who can lead teams and manage clients become scarcer as tools improve productivity. The vulnerable position is a production artist limited to routine visual work.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with a bachelor's degree in visual design, then develop your aesthetic judgment and portfolio while at school. Pure image-production work is shrinking in the AI era, so start practicing creative strategy early.
Move beyond making visuals to setting direction and leading a team. Learn generative tools and work toward becoming an art director.
Highlight your creative direction and team leadership experience, and specify the campaigns you supported. Employers value sound aesthetic judgment and dependable execution.
Do not hire solely for speed in making visuals. Look for someone who understands brand character and visual tone. An art director who can coordinate the whole effort is worth a higher salary.

ai_s7_trends: Generative tools raise productivity while routine production art contracts.
Demand for digital and branded content is growing.
Art directors with creative strategy skills are increasingly sought after.

body: Art directors (Art Directors) coordinate the visual style of advertising, publishing, film, television, and brands. They define art direction and tone, guide designers and Photographers, oversee layouts, imagery, and final output quality, and align work with client needs.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Generative tools can produce ten visual options in seconds, but the art director still decides which one fits the brand and whether it delivers the feeling the client wants.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 生成式工具能秒出十版图，但哪版和品牌对味、客户要的那种「感觉」对不对，还是艺术总监定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年艺术总监在岗约 13.50 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.07 万人，净增约 0.57 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.23 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 11.10 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代艺术总监，但会加速出图与排版。Midjourney、排版与设计工具把素材与版式提速，艺术总监从「自己画」挪向「定方向、审审美、带团队、对客户」。真正被挤掉的是只做常规美编的执行者，有创意策略力的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 创意方案快速探索
素材智能检索
成片质量初筛
多版并行迭代
ai_s2_auto: 生成式出图与素材
AI 排版与版式
风格迁移与配色
草图自动上色
ai_s3_list: 创意方向：靠人。
审美判断：靠练。
客户协调：靠扯。
成片把控：靠眼。
策略统筹：靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的出图区——素材排版被系统吃，但方向与协调还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「常规美编与出图」动作，不是「创意统筹」的岗位。有审美主见、能带团队对客户的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会做常规图的美编。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 视觉设计本科打底，在校多练审美和作品集。AI 时代纯出图在缩，早点练创意策略。
从「画图」升级成「定方向 + 带团队」，学生成式工具，争取当艺术总监。
突出创意方向与带人经验，写清跟过哪些 campaign。公司看重审美和稳。
选人别只看画图快，要看有没有调性脑子。能统筹的艺术总监，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 生成式提效，常规美编缩。
数字与品牌内容需求涨。
有创意策略力的总监更抢手。

body: 艺术总监（Art Directors）统筹广告、出版、影视与品牌的视觉风格，制定美术方案与调性，指导设计师与摄影师，把控版面、画面与成片质量，并对接客户需求。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 生成式工具能秒出十版图，但哪版和品牌对味、客户要的那种「感觉」对不对，还是艺术总监定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Fire-control systems are becoming more intelligent, but people will always decide whether to strike, how to strike, and which unit should execute the mission.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. military pay follows the Department of Defense rank and years-of-service system. Civilian BLS OES data does not cover military occupations, so this page does not provide a U.S. median. Salary references use Chinese mainland proxy data (Aiqicha and other public sources, sample of 10, 2026-08).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace artillery and missile officers, but it will profoundly change how they fight. Intelligent fire-control systems increasingly handle ballistic calculation, target recognition, and fire allocation, ending the era of manual tables and memorized formulas. Officers are shifting from calculating firing data to making decisions: which weapon to use, which target to engage, how to allocate fires, and how to avoid countermeasures. AI cannot assume these tactical judgments, command responsibilities, or troop-leadership duties.
ai_s2_accel: Unmanned reconnaissance and AI-assisted target location support decisions
Intelligent fire-control systems sharply reduce response time
Training simulators enable realistic combat exercises
Data-link systems improve coordinated strike efficiency
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation of ballistic calculations and firing data
Automated target recognition and threat prioritization
Intelligent assistance with fire allocation and coordination
Equipment condition monitoring and maintenance reminders
ai_s3_list: Tactical decisions: judging whether to engage in a complex battlefield environment and accepting responsibility for that choice.
Troop leadership: organizing training, management, and cohesion to build combat effectiveness.
Immediate adaptation: responding quickly to equipment failures and battlefield surprises.
Command responsibility: commanders remain accountable for the effects of fires.
Equipment understanding: human-machine coordination and tactical use of new weapon systems.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 means fire-control systems handle many mechanical calculation tasks, while command decisions and unit management remain a large share of the role, placing AI exposure relatively low within the career system.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not permit complacency. Intelligent equipment evolves quickly, and officers who do not understand new systems or data-link operations will be marginalized. The real trend favors officers who combine command ability with technical knowledge. AI is equipment; officers are responsible for mastering it.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Apply to a military academy or defense-related institution and build a strong foundation in mathematics and physics. Focus on intelligent warfare fields such as command, unmanned systems, and information confrontation, which align more closely with future battlefields and can improve assignment prospects after graduation.

Master intelligent fire control, coordination with unmanned aircraft, and data-link operations, and actively seek conversion training on new equipment. Develop both command and technical ability; understanding new equipment is a meaningful advantage in promotion assessments.

Plan civilian transition options early. Defense industry, emergency management, security and fire services, and local administration all value military backgrounds. Describe command management, equipment maintenance, and emergency-response experience on your resume instead of relying on a generic statement about military service.

When defense and emergency organizations hire, they should evaluate more than educational credentials. Military command and equipment-management experience are scarce assets. Clear skill certification and transition pathways for former officers help put that experience to effective use.

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent fire control and unmanned equipment are reshaping artillery operations, shifting officers toward command decisions.
Rapid advances in precision guidance and information confrontation increase the value of officers who understand technology and can command effectively.
Military training is becoming more simulation-based and routine, with steadily higher standards for realistic combat exercises.

body: Artillery and missile officers command and manage artillery and missile units. They direct firing, coordinate fires, organize positions, manage equipment, and train personnel so fire units complete missions in combat and exercises.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Fire-control systems are becoming more intelligent, but people will always decide whether to strike, how to strike, and which unit should execute the mission.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 火控系统越来越智能，但「打不打、怎么打、派谁打」的决定，永远是人来做。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国军用薪酬由国防部等级制（军衔+年限）决定，民用 BLS OES 不统计军事职业，本页不提供美国中位数口径；薪资参考以中国大陆代理数据为准（爱企查等公开渠道，采样 10 条，2026-08）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代火炮导弹军官，但会深度改变作战方式：弹道计算、目标识别、火力分配正在被智能化火控系统接管，过去靠算盘和口诀的时代已经过去。军官的职责重心从「算诸元」转向「做决策」——用什么兵器、打什么目标、怎么分配火力、如何规避反制，这些战术判断、指挥责任和带兵能力，是 AI 无法承担的。
ai_s2_accel: 无人侦察与 AI 目标定位辅助决策
智能化火控系统大幅缩短反应时间
训练仿真系统逼真化实战演练
数据链体系提升协同打击效率
ai_s2_auto: 弹道计算与射击诸元自动生成
目标识别与威胁排序自动化
火力分配与协同的智能辅助
装备状态监测与维护提醒
ai_s3_list: 战术决策：复杂战场环境下打与不打的判断与责任。
带兵能力：训练、管理、凝聚战斗力的组织力。
临场应变：装备故障、战场意外时的快速处置。
指挥责任：火力命中的责任由指挥官承担。
装备理解：新武器系统的人机协同与战术运用。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业的机械化计算环节被火控系统大量接管，但指挥决策与部队管理占比高，AI 接触面在职业体系中处于低位。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光并不代表可以躺平：智能化装备迭代极快，不懂新系统、不会数据链路运用的军官会被边缘化。真正的趋势是「会指挥 + 懂技术」的复合型军官更受重用，AI 是装备，军官是驾驭装备的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 报考军校或国防相关院校，数学物理是基础。瞄准智能化方向：指挥、无人装备、信息对抗这些新专业更贴合未来战场，毕业分配的岗位前景更好。
把智能化火控、无人机协同、数据链运用学透，主动申请新装备换装培训。指挥与技术两手抓，晋升考评里「懂新装备」是硬加分项。
退役转业方向要提前规划：国防工业、应急管理、安保消防、地方行政都接受军事背景。把指挥管理、装备维护、应急经验写进简历，比泛泛的「军旅经历」有用。
国防工业与应急系统招人时，别只认学历，军事指挥与装备管理经验是稀缺资产。为转业军官设计清晰的能力认证与转岗通道，能把好钢用在刀刃上。

ai_s7_trends: 智能化火控与无人装备重塑炮兵作战，军官转向指挥决策层。
精确制导与信息对抗迭代加快，懂技术会指挥的军官更受重视。
军事训练仿真化、常态化，实战化演练要求持续提高。

body: 火炮导弹军官在军队中指挥与管理火炮、导弹部队：负责射击指挥、火力协调、阵地组织、装备管理与官兵训练，确保火力分队在实战和演习中完成任务。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 火控系统越来越智能，但「打不打、怎么打、派谁打」的决定，永远是人来做。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Irrigation can be automated, but farmworkers still use their hands and eyes to decide how to transplant seedlings, identify diseased leaves, and harvest fruit.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 504,800 Farmworkers and Laborers, Crop, Nursery, and Greenhouse were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 488,100 by 2034, a net decrease of about 16,700 jobs, with about 71,700 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $35,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace these jobs, but it will reduce time spent on environmental controls. Automated irrigation and climate control accelerate routine care, shifting people from watering to transplanting, pollinating, identifying disease, and harvesting precisely. Workers who only perform simple irrigation face the greatest pressure, while those skilled in plant care and disease recognition gain value.
ai_s2_accel: Disease alerts
Yield forecasting
Farm activity scheduling
Harvesting assistance
ai_s2_auto: Automated irrigation
Climate-control adjustments
Seedling production lines
Weighing and sorting
ai_s3_list: Transplanting and care: people provide the touch.
Pollination and harvesting: people provide the eye.
Disease recognition: people make the judgment.
Precision sorting: people judge the fine distinctions.
On-site adaptation: people respond to weather.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in the relatively low AI-exposure tier. Manual farm work remains central and is difficult for systems to absorb, although climate-control technology will continue to spread.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean high risk. Watering and simple climate-control tasks are being replaced, not the whole job of raising plants and harvesting crops. Workers skilled in plant care and disease recognition can become scarcer as mechanization advances.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Learn plant care and disease recognition. Basic watering work is declining, so develop precision-care and sorting skills early.
Advance from physical labor to plant care plus disease recognition, and pursue responsibility for a field section or greenhouse.
Emphasize farmwork experience and stamina. Production sites value reliability and attention to detail.
Do not select workers only for strength. Assess plant-care and disease-recognition skills, and retain strong workers who can lead crews.

ai_s7_trends: Climate control spreads and watering work declines.
Precision plant care gains importance.
Workers who recognize disease are in greater demand.

body: Crop, nursery, and greenhouse farmworkers transplant, tend, pollinate, weed, and harvest crops. They maintain growing conditions to support yield and quality.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Irrigation can be automated, but farmworkers still use their hands and eyes to decide how to transplant seedlings, identify diseased leaves, and harvest fruit.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 灌溉能自动，但苗怎么移栽、病叶怎么辨、果怎么采，还是农工的手眼定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年农场工人与劳工、作物、苗圃、温室在岗约 50.48 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 48.81 万人，岗位净减约 1.67 万个，年均产生约 7.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.57 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会压缩环控时间。灌溉与环控自动化把常规管护提速，人从「浇水」挪向「移栽、授粉、病害识别、精细采收」。真正被挤掉的是只做简单灌溉的，会管护、能辨病的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 病害预警
产量预测
农事排程
采摘辅助
ai_s2_auto: 自动灌溉
环控调节
育苗线
称重分拣
ai_s3_list: 移栽管护：手感靠人。
授粉采收：眼力靠人。
病害识别：判断靠人。
精细分拣：分寸靠人。
现场应变：看天靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光——核心是手工农事，系统暂时难接手，但环控会慢慢渗透。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「浇水与简单环控」动作，不是「养苗采收」的岗位。会管护、能辨病的人，反而随机械化更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学管护与辨病，纯浇水在缩，早点练精细与分拣。
从「体力」升级成「管护 + 病害识别」，争取带片或带棚。
突出农事经验与耐劳，基地看重稳和细。
选人别只看力气，要看会不会管护和辨病，能带工的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 环控普及，浇水缩。
精细管护更被看重。
会辨病的人更抢手。

body: 作物、苗圃与温室农工从事移栽、管护、授粉、除草与采收等农事劳动，维护作物生长环境，保障产量与品质。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 灌溉能自动，但苗怎么移栽、病叶怎么辨、果怎么采，还是农工的手眼定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Drones can patrol remote terrain, but wardens still decide how to respond on site and apply the law.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 7,000 Fish And Game Wardens employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 6,600 by 2034, a net decrease of about 400 jobs, with about 500 annual openings. The 2026 median annual wage is about $68,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Fish And Game Wardens, but it will change patrol work. Drones, remote sensing, and camera traps handle parts of routine patrols. Wardens shift from manual counting toward field enforcement, wildlife rescue, and conflict response. Simple counting patrols are shrinking, while people with enforcement and field experience become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Alerts for suspected violations
Intelligent population estimates
Patrol route optimization
Assisted rescue dispatch
ai_s2_auto: Automated drone patrols
Remote-sensing image recognition
Camera-trap counting
Automated record generation
ai_s3_list: Field enforcement: people make the judgment.
Rescue response: people apply field experience.
Conflict resolution: people understand human relationships.
Field judgment: people make tradeoffs.
Public education: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure in field enforcement. Technology accelerates patrols, but people remain central to enforcement and rescue.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high career risk. Technology replaces counting patrols, not field enforcement and rescue roles. Qualified people who can handle incidents become scarcer as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study biology or environmental science, build fitness early, and pursue enforcement qualifications. Do not enter the field only because you want to observe animals.
Advance from patrol work to enforcement + rescue, and learn drone and data skills.
Emphasize field and enforcement experience. Protected areas value people who can work independently.
Do not select candidates on fitness alone. Assess whether they can handle emergencies and enforce laws.

ai_s7_trends: Drones improve patrol efficiency as adoption expands.
Ecological conservation receives greater attention.
People with enforcement capability have greater stability.

body: Fish And Game Wardens patrol waterways and forests under legal authority. They enforce fishing and hunting laws, rescue and monitor wildlife, investigate violations, and protect habitats.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Drones can patrol remote terrain, but wardens still decide how to respond on site and apply the law.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 无人机能巡山，但现场怎么处置、法规怎么用，还是管理员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年鱼类与野生动物管理员在岗约 0.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.66 万人，岗位净减约 0.04 万个，年均产生约 0.05 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.82 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代管理员，但会改变巡护。无人机、遥感和相机陷阱分担日常巡查，管理员从「走路数」挪向「现场执法、救助与冲突处置」。被挤掉的是单纯计数巡护，有执法与野外经验的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 违法线索预警
种群智能估算
巡护路线优化
救助调度辅助
ai_s2_auto: 无人机自动巡护
遥感影像识别
相机陷阱计数
台账自动生成
ai_s3_list: 现场执法：判断靠人。
救助处置：经验靠人。
冲突化解：人情靠人。
野外判断：取舍靠人。
宣教沟通：信任靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的野外执法区——巡护被技术加速，但执法与救助还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「计数巡护」，不是「现场执法与救助」的岗位。有资格、能处置的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学生物/环境，早练体能和执法资格，别只想看动物。
从「巡护」升级成「执法 + 救助」，学无人机与数据。
突出野外与执法经历，保护区看重能独当一面。
选人别只看体力，看他能不能处置突发和执法。

ai_s7_trends: 无人机普及，巡护提效。
生态保育受重视。
有执法力的人更稳。

body: 鱼类与野生动物管理员依法巡护水域与林地，监督渔猎法规，救助与监测野生动物，查处违法并保护栖息地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 无人机能巡山，但现场怎么处置、法规怎么用，还是管理员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can tell you three days in advance that the machine is going to break down from the vibration data, but after disassembly, "whether the bearing fits properly back together" still depends on the hand of the machinist.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be approximately 439,600 industrial machinery mechanics on the job in 2024, and the number is expected to rise to 510,300 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 70,700 positions, an average annual vacancy of approximately 45,700, and a median annual salary of approximately US$63,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI won’t replace industrial machine mechanics, but it will change the way diagnostics are done. Sensors and predictive maintenance systems can warn of faults in advance. Mechanics have shifted from "waiting for something to break and then repairing it" to "proactive maintenance based on data." Data dashboards are increasingly used in diagnostic processes. What is really scarce is the disassembly and judgment ability to turn data prompts into actual maintenance actions.
ai_s2_accel: AI-Assisted Vibration/Thermal Imaging Failure Analysis
AR remote collaboration guides complex disassembly and assembly
Continuous optimization of predictive maintenance models
Rapid manufacturing of 3D printed spare parts
ai_s2_auto: Equipment status monitoring and abnormal warning
Automatic dispatch and scheduling of maintenance work orders
Automatic inventory counting and replenishment suggestions for spare parts inventory
Digitization of equipment files and maintenance records
ai_s3_list: On-site diagnosis: The data says "there is a problem." The exact location and extent of the problem depend on experience and feel.
Disassembly and assembly skills: torque, clearance, assembly sequence, the machine will not tell you, the master will.
Judgment of abnormal noise and touch: Using ears and fingers to find problems is an experience that cannot be replaced by sensors.
Emergency judgment: What to secure first and how to secure the emergency repair site must have an overall view.
Collaborate with the production line: how long the shutdown will last and how to arrange the maintenance window depends on communication between people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 shows that the data aspects of this industry - monitoring, scheduling, spare parts - are being taken over by AI, but the core "repair" is still the combination of physical strength and technology.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But low-medium risk does not mean there is no change: old masters who rely purely on experience are the most stable, and middle-level positions that "can only change parts but cannot judge" are the most stressful. Mechanics who master digital diagnostic tools will adapt faster than their peers.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Mechatronics and mechanical maintenance are practical majors with a wide range of employment opportunities. Learn the basics of electrician and welder certificates and PLC in advance. Comprehensive mechanics who can read data and perform repairs are most in short supply.

Actively learn sensors, predictive maintenance and condition monitoring tools to move time from "waiting for failure" to "active maintenance". The experience of old masters + new tools is the most stable combination in this industry.

If you have experience as a fitter, welder or equipment operator, you can get started. You can first take the basic certificate and then start as an apprentice. The maintenance industry relies on skills and sense of responsibility. Those who are willing to work hard and learn have wider prospects than imagined.

When recruiting mechanics, don’t just look at their years of experience, but also based on the faults they have handled independently. Equipping old masters with digital diagnostic tools and new apprentices is the most practical way to solve the technical gap.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Vibration/temperature online monitoring and early warning
Hot spot and insulation abnormality detection
Experts remotely mark the disassembly and assembly steps
On-site processing and repair of parts

ai_s7_trends: Predictive maintenance has become a standard feature in factories, and mechanics have shifted from "rush repair" to "maintenance based on data."
The retirement of old technicians has created a talent gap, and young mechanics have increased their bargaining power after mastering digital tools.
As devices become smarter and more complex, the composite capabilities of mechanics + electrical + data become the core.

body: Industrial machinery mechanics are responsible for the installation, debugging, inspection and fault repair of industrial equipment and machinery. They ensure the stable operation of the production line through diagnosis, disassembly, replacement of parts and preventive maintenance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can tell you three days in advance that the machine is going to break down from the vibration data, but after disassembly, "whether the bearing fits properly back together" still depends on the hand of the machinist.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能从振动数据里提前三天告诉你机器要坏，但拆开之后「这颗轴承装回去合不合适」，还得靠机械师的手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工业机械机械师在岗约 43.96 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 51.03 万人，净增约 7.07 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.57 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.38 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代工业机械机械师，但会改变诊断方式。传感器和预测性维护系统能提前预警故障，机械师从「等坏了再修」转向「按数据主动保养」，诊断环节也越来越多借助数据看板。真正稀缺的，是把数据提示变成实际维修动作的拆装和判断能力。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助的振动/热成像故障分析
AR 远程协作指导复杂拆装
预测性维护模型的持续优化
3D 打印备件的快速制造
ai_s2_auto: 设备状态监测与异常预警
维修工单的自动派发与排期
备件库存的自动盘点与补货建议
设备档案与维修记录的数字化
ai_s3_list: 现场诊断：数据说「有问题」，具体哪儿坏、坏到什么程度，得靠经验和手感。
拆装手艺：扭矩、间隙、装配顺序，机器不会告诉你，师傅会。
异响与触感判断：用耳朵和手指找问题，是传感器替代不了的经验。
应急判断：抢修现场先保什么、怎么保，要有大局观。
与产线协同：停机多久、怎么安排检修窗口，靠人和人的沟通。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行的数据环节——监测、排期、备件——正在被 AI 接管，但核心的「修」仍然是体力与手艺的结合。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低-中风险不等于没变化：纯靠经验的老师傅最稳，中间层「只会换件、不会判断」的岗位压力最大。掌握数字化诊断工具的机械师，会比同行更快适应。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机电一体化、机械维修是实用专业，就业面宽。把电工、焊工证书和 PLC 基础提前学起来，会看数据又会上手修的复合型机械师最缺。
主动学传感器、预测性维护和状态监测工具，把时间从「等故障」挪到「主动保养」。老师傅的经验 + 新工具，是这行最稳的组合。
有钳工、焊工或设备操作经验就能切入，先考基础证书再从学徒做起。维修行业看手艺和责任心，肯干肯学的人出路比想象中宽。
招机械师别只看年限，要看独立处理过哪些故障。给老师傅配数字化诊断工具和新学徒，是解决技术断档最实际的办法。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 振动/温度在线监测预警
专家远程标注拆装步骤
频谱分析、故障模式识别

ai_s7_trends: 预测性维护成为工厂标配，机械师从「抢修」转向「按数据保养」。
老技师退休带来人才断层，年轻机械师掌握数字工具后议价力上升。
设备越智能越复杂，机械 + 电气 + 数据的复合能力成为核心。

body: 工业机械机械师负责工业设备与机械的安装、调试、检修和故障维修，通过诊断、拆装、更换零部件和预防性维护，保障生产线的稳定运行。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能从振动数据里提前三天告诉你机器要坏，但拆开之后「这颗轴承装回去合不合适」，还得靠机械师的手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can handle medical records and educational materials, but a midwife must personally stay with a mother through every contraction and every breath.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 41,700 midwives were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 43,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,400 jobs, with roughly 2,600 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $64,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace midwives, but it will take over a great deal of desk work: electronic medical records, health education materials, monitoring data entry, and follow-up reminders. Much of the paperwork that consumes midwives' time is being automated. The time saved should go back to the bedside for companionship, reassurance, observation, and delivery care. Assessing labor and responding to emergencies depend on human observation and hands-on judgment; AI currently serves only as an assistive tool.
ai_s2_accel: AI-powered early warnings for abnormal fetal heart patterns
Intelligent risk assessment for high-risk pregnancies
Remote fetal heart monitoring and at-home monitoring
Virtual simulation systems for midwifery training
ai_s2_auto: Automated generation of electronic medical records and prenatal care notes
Automated interpretation alerts for fetal heart monitoring data
Generation of maternal health education materials
Digital follow-up reminders and record management
ai_s3_list: Hands-on delivery skills: proper technique and judgment in perineal protection and newborn care.
Labor assessment: experience builds the intuition to know when to wait and when to call a physician.
Emotional reassurance: machines cannot provide the warmth of a midwife's presence and words when a mother is afraid.
Emergency response: every second counts during postpartum hemorrhage or neonatal asphyxia.
Ethics and accountability: maternal and infant safety is non-negotiable, and every decision carries responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates substantial AI exposure in documentation and education, while the high proportion of direct care in the delivery room makes this a career with moderately high exposure and strong on-site dependence.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean safe or dangerous. What will shrink is support work limited to routine recordkeeping and lacking professional judgment. Midwives who treat AI alerts as a reference while making final decisions from experience will become even more valuable. Society will not entrust the non-negotiable standard of maternal and infant safety to algorithms alone.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Women make up the great majority of midwifery students, but men also have opportunities and can have a physical advantage in the delivery room. Seek extensive clinical placements during school, develop strong delivery and labor-assessment skills, and pass the licensing exam on the first attempt.

Use AI medical-record and intelligent fetal heart interpretation tools to give more time back to bedside care. Develop expertise in areas such as midwifery clinics, breastfeeding support, and prenatal and postpartum education, progressing from delivery skills to comprehensive maternal and infant care across the full cycle.

Moving from nursing into midwifery requires additional professional training and qualifications. In job applications, emphasize delivery-room placements, the number of births attended, and emergency-response experience. Maternal care providers and postpartum care centers also hire qualified professionals with midwifery backgrounds.

Do not bury midwives in paperwork. Equip them with AI documentation tools so they can return to the bedside. Clear advancement paths and night-shift compensation help retain experienced midwives and cost less than repeatedly recruiting new staff.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Continuous fetal heart rate and contraction monitoring
Prenatal visit reminders and educational content

ai_s7_trends: AI fetal heart interpretation and risk alerts become standard in delivery rooms, freeing midwives to devote more time to direct care.
Stronger fertility-support policies expand midwifery clinics and comprehensive maternal and infant services.
The spread of family-centered childbirth and compassionate midwifery makes communication and supportive care more valuable.

body: Midwives provide prenatal care, monitor labor and attend births, deliver postpartum and newborn care, educate families about maternal health, and identify high-risk factors for timely referral. They are indispensable professionals in maternal and infant healthcare.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can handle medical records and educational materials, but a midwife must personally stay with a mother through every contraction and every breath.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 病历和宣教素材交给 AI，但产妇的每一次宫缩和每一声喘息，都得助产士亲自陪着。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年助产士在岗约 4.17 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.31 万人，净增约 0.14 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.26 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.40 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代助产士，但会接手大量案头活：电子病历、健康宣教素材、监护数据记录、随访提醒——这些占助产士不少时间的文书工作正在被自动化。省下的时间应该回到产妇床边：陪伴、安抚、观察、接产。产程判断和危急处置依赖的是人眼的观察与人的手感，AI 目前只是辅助工具。
ai_s2_accel: AI 胎心监护异常早期预警
高危妊娠风险智能评估
远程胎心监护与居家监测
虚拟仿真助产培训系统
ai_s2_auto: 电子病历与产检记录自动生成
胎心监护数据的自动判读提醒
孕产健康宣教素材的生成
随访提醒与档案管理电子化
ai_s3_list: 接产技术手感：会阴保护、新生儿处理的规范与分寸。
产程判断：什么时候等、什么时候喊医生，是经验积累的直觉。
情绪安抚：产妇恐惧时的陪伴与语言，机器给不了温度。
危急处置：产后出血、新生儿窒息时的分秒必争。
伦理与责任：母婴安全一票否决，每个决定都要担责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明文书与宣教环节的 AI 接触面较大，但产房现场的直接照护比例高，属于「中高曝光、高现场依赖」的职业。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于安全，也不等于危险——真正被压缩的是只会机械做记录、缺乏判断的辅助性工作。会把 AI 预警当参考、又能凭经验做最终判断的助产士，价值只会更高。母婴安全这个底线，社会不可能交给纯算法。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 助产专业女生占绝大多数，但男生同样有机会，且在产房体能上是优势。读书期间多进临床实习，把接产和产程判断练出来，执业证一次考过。
把 AI 病历与胎心智能判读工具用起来，时间还给产妇床边。往助产门诊、母乳喂养指导、孕产教育等细分方向走，从「会接产」升级为「懂全周期母婴照护」。
护理背景转助产需要补助产专业培训与资格证。求职时突出产房实习、接产例数与危急处理经历，母婴机构、月子中心也在招有助产背景的专业人才。
别让助产士陷在文书里，配 AI 记录工具把人放回床边。给助产士清晰的晋升通道和夜班补偿，留住有经验的助产士，比反复招新人更划算。

ai_s7_trends: AI 胎心判读与风险预警成为产房标配，助产士更多投入直接照护。
生育支持政策加码，助产门诊与全周期母婴服务扩容。
家庭化分娩与人文助产理念推广，沟通与陪伴能力更值钱。

body: 助产士为孕产妇提供妊娠期保健、产程观察与接产、产后护理及新生儿照护，开展孕产健康宣教，并识别高危因素及时转诊，是母婴保健体系中不可替代的专业角色。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 病历和宣教素材交给 AI，但产妇的每一次宫缩和每一声喘息，都得助产士亲自陪着。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can solve neutron transport equations extremely quickly, but a nuclear engineer must still decide whether a conservative assumption is conservative enough.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 15,400 nuclear engineers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 15,300 by 2034, a net loss of about 100 jobs, with roughly 800 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $127,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace nuclear engineers, but it will change calculation work. Safety analyses that once took several days can now converge quickly with AI and supercomputing, while surrogate models assist parameter optimization previously guided by experience. Core responsibilities such as design decisions, safety reviews, and response to operational anomalies still require people. AI provides results, but only engineers bear responsibility for deciding whether to use them.
ai_s2_accel: AI design optimization: surrogate models assist reactor-parameter searches
Digital-twin power plant: real-time operating-state replication and drills
Intelligent equipment diagnostics: vibration- and temperature-driven failure prediction
Radiation-dose prediction: AI-assisted shielding design and dose optimization
ai_s2_auto: Neutron-physics and thermal calculations: AI surrogate models accelerate core simulation
Safety-analysis assistance: automatic matching of accident-scenario libraries and parameter generation
Operational-data monitoring: automatic recognition and alerts for abnormal patterns
Fuel burnup management: automated tracking and loading-pattern optimization
ai_s3_list: Nuclear-safety judgment and accountability: calculations are references, while engineers set safety boundaries.
Experience-based design intuition: long experience determines which parameters remain conservative and which can be optimized.
On-the-spot anomaly response: people decide whether to shut down or continue when operating data become abnormal.
Interdisciplinary systems integration: oversee physics, thermal hydraulics, mechanics, instrumentation, and procedures across the full chain.
Regulatory communication and compliance understanding: translating engineering language into regulatory requirements is a core soft skill.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 reflects the substantial share of computation in this occupation. AI greatly accelerates reactor physics, thermal hydraulics, and safety analysis, but only assists with core design decisions, safety reviews, and anomaly response.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Nuclear power is a zero-tolerance industry. However quickly AI calculates, it cannot assume responsibility for safety decisions. Junior functions limited to running calculations face pressure, while senior nuclear engineers who review results and make decisions become scarcer and more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study nuclear engineering, nuclear physics, or energy and power engineering as an undergraduate, then specialize in reactor physics or safety analysis in graduate school. Build strong mathematics and physics fundamentals. Nuclear power is entering a revival cycle, and joining a state-owned nuclear power company offers a stable, respected path worth serious consideration.

Use AI simulation tools and surrogate models, and invest the saved time in nuclear-safety review and interdisciplinary integration. Pursue credentials such as Registered Nuclear Safety Engineer and follow an expert track. AI will replace calculations, not review and decisions.

People with energy, mechanical, or electrical backgrounds can transition into nuclear engineering by joining an advanced nuclear company or design institute and adding nuclear-safety knowledge. Quantify achievements such as units supported and safety-analysis projects. Registration and nuclear-safety training are major advantages.

Do not hire nuclear engineers based only on calculation speed. Assess safety awareness and decision-making. Engineers who use AI, question its results, and carry zero-tolerance responsibility deserve more investment than people with purely computational backgrounds.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Neutron transport, criticality, and burnup calculations
Fast parameter optimization and approximate calculations
Data-driven failure prediction from vibration and temperature

ai_s7_trends: The nuclear revival and carbon neutrality drive record numbers of approved and under-construction units in China, sustaining demand and creating a clear talent shortage.
SMRs, Generation IV reactors, and fusion research open new paths, with AI simulation becoming standard in design.
The industry's zero-tolerance nature remains unchanged. Engineer value concentrates in reviewing results, making decisions, and bearing responsibility. AI replaces calculation, not judgment.

body: Nuclear engineers design, operate, maintain, and analyze the safety of nuclear-energy systems, including reactor-physics and thermal-hydraulic calculations, fuel management, radiation protection, nuclear-safety assessment, and facility decommissioning.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can solve neutron transport equations extremely quickly, but a nuclear engineer must still decide whether a conservative assumption is conservative enough.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把中子输运方程算得飞快，但「这个保守假设是否够保守」的拍板，还得核工程师来做。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年核工程师在岗约 1.54 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.53 万人，岗位净减约 0.01 万个，年均产生约 0.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.75 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代核工程师，但会改变「算」这件事。以前一个安全分析要跑几天的计算，现在 AI 加超算能快速收敛；以前靠经验判断的参数优化，现在有代理模型辅助搜索。可设计决策、安全评审、运行异常处置这些核心，还得靠人——AI 给你结果，但「敢不敢用这个结果」的责任，只有工程师来担。
ai_s2_accel: AI 设计优化：代理模型辅助反应堆参数寻优
数字孪生电厂：运行状态实时镜像与演练
设备智能诊断：振动、温度数据驱动故障预测
辐射剂量预测：AI 辅助屏蔽设计与剂量优化
ai_s2_auto: 中子物理与热工计算：AI 代理模型加速堆芯仿真
安全分析报告辅助：事故场景库自动匹配与参数生成
运行数据监控：异常模式自动识别与预警
燃料燃耗管理：自动跟踪与装料方案优化
ai_s3_list: 核安全判断与责任担当：计算结果是参考，安全边界怎么定，工程师来拍板。
设计决策的经验直觉：哪些参数保守、哪些可以优化，靠的是长期积累。
异常处置的临场判断：运行数据异常时，怎么权衡停机与继续，要人决策。
跨学科系统整合：物理、热工、机械、仪表、规程，全链路把关。
监管沟通与合规理解：把工程语言翻译成监管要求，是核心软技能。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有相当一部分工作在重计算上——堆物理、热工、安全分析正被 AI 大幅加速，但设计决策、安全评审、异常处置这些核心，AI 只能辅助。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。核行业是零容错行业，AI 算得再快，也替代不了「拍板安全」的责任。真正被挤压的是「纯跑计算、不碰决策」的初级工程师职能，会审结果、会做决策的资深核工程师反而更稀缺、更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 本科读核工程、核物理或能源动力，研究生阶段往反应堆物理、安全分析方向走。数理基础要扎实，别怕数学。核电正迎来复兴周期，进核电央企是稳定且受尊敬的路径，值得认真考虑。
把 AI 仿真工具和代理模型用起来，省下的时间花在核安全评审能力和跨专业整合上。考注册核安全工程师等资质，往专家路线走——计算会被 AI 替代，评审和决策不会。
能源、机械、电气背景转核工程可行，先进核电企业或设计院积累，再补核安全知识。简历上写「参与机组数量、安全分析项目」这类可量化成果。注册资质和核安全培训是硬加分项。
招核工程师别只看计算速度，要看安全意识和决策能力。能用 AI 工具、又懂得质疑 AI 结果、扛得住零容错责任的工程师，比纯计算背景的人更值得投入。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 中子输运、临界与燃耗计算
冷却剂流动与传热模拟
快速参数寻优、近似计算
振动温度数据驱动故障预测
屏蔽设计、剂量分布计算

ai_s7_trends: 核电复兴叠加碳中和，国内核准在建机组创新高，核工程师需求持续上升，人才缺口明显。
SMR（小型模块化堆）、四代堆与聚变研究打开新赛道，AI 仿真成为设计标配。
零容错行业属性不变，工程师价值向「审结果、做决策、担责任」集中，AI 替代的是计算而非判断。

body: 核工程师负责核能系统的设计、运行、维护与安全分析，包括反应堆物理与热工水力计算、燃料管理、辐射防护、核安全评估以及核设施退役等。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把中子输运方程算得飞快，但「这个保守假设是否够保守」的拍板，还得核工程师来做。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can help with checkout, stocking, and promotions, but when a customer stands by the shelf and asks whether something suits them, a person still needs to answer.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 451,500 retail sales workers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 491,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 39,800 jobs, with about 51,300 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $37,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will replace some retail sales jobs, but mainly the transactional steps. Self-checkout, smart replenishment, and online recommendations divert payment and basic stocking work, shifting sales workers from taking payments at counters toward experiential service and consultative recommendations. Face-to-face judgment, fitting guidance, handling customer emotions, and turning one-time shoppers into repeat customers remain irreplaceable because they require human relationships.
ai_s2_accel: Trials of AI sales assistants and smart fitting rooms
Integrated online and offline order fulfillment
Foot-traffic analysis and in-store heat-map recommendations
Expanded testing of cashierless stores
ai_s2_auto: Self-checkout and mobile payments
Inventory counts and smart replenishment
Automated promotions and membership management
Electronic price labels and display information
ai_s3_list: Face-to-face recommendations: customers say they are just browsing, but insight reveals what they actually want.
Fitting and experience guidance: machines cannot replace advice on size, styling, and fit.
Handling customer emotions: communication stabilizes complaints, returns, and difficult interactions.
Repeat-customer relationships: AI can prompt staff, but people remember preferences, retain customers, and encourage repeat purchases.
Flexible in-store response: people judge substitutes for out-of-stock products and manage unexpected crowds.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means automation is taking over transactions and processes such as checkout, inventory counts, replenishment, and promotional messaging.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. As AI handles transactions, sales workers must provide better service and understand customer experience. Face-to-face service and repeat-customer relationships become more important. Pure checkout and stocking roles face pressure, while sales workers in experiential stores and high-ticket categories remain sought after.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Retail is useful for part-time study and transitional employment but is not recommended as a long-term plan. To stay in the field, study marketing or retail operations and plan toward store and operations management instead of remaining a sales associate.

Master sales techniques and membership data tools, and actively pursue store leadership and operations training. Advancing from selling products to becoming a store manager who understands data and leads teams is retail's most stable promotion path.

Retail has low entry barriers and quick onboarding, making it suitable for transitions and socially oriented people. On your resume, quantify sales target attainment, repeat-purchase contribution, and execution of store campaigns.

Do not hire sales staff based only on appearance; evaluate service mindset and willingness to learn. Employees who adapt to self-checkout and data tools while maintaining repeat-customer relationships are core assets in store transformation.

ai_s7_trends: As self-checkout and smart replenishment spread, purely transactional jobs are shrinking and store staffing is concentrating on experiential service and operations.
Integrated online and offline retail is becoming standard, increasing demand for versatile retail professionals who understand data, run operations, and lead stores.
Experiential and new consumer-brand stores are expanding, repricing the value of face-to-face service and increasing demand for people who both sell and retain customers.

body: Retail sales workers recommend products, serve customers, process payments, arrange displays, and replenish stock in retail stores. They directly deliver the sales and service process and form the industry's frontline workforce.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can help with checkout, stocking, and promotions, but when a customer stands by the shelf and asks whether something suits them, a person still needs to answer.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你收银、理货、推优惠，但顾客站在货架前那句「您看这个适合吗」，还得人来说。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年零售销售人员在岗约 45.15 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 49.13 万人，净增约 3.98 万个岗位，年均产生约 5.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.71 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 会取代一部分零售销售岗位，但取代的是「纯交易环节」。自助收银、智能补货、线上推荐分流了结算和基础理货，销售员从「站柜台收钱」转向「体验服务与顾问式推荐」。真正不可替代的是面对面的推荐判断、试穿引导、处理顾客情绪，以及把一次性顾客变成复购熟客的关系经营——这需要人对人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 导购与智能试衣间试点
线上线下一体化订单履约
客流分析与店内热力推荐
无人零售门店扩大试验
ai_s2_auto: 自助收银与移动支付结算
库存盘点与智能补货
促销推送与会员管理自动化
价格标签与陈列信息电子化
ai_s3_list: 面对面推荐判断：顾客嘴上说随便看看，实际想要什么，靠眼力。
试穿与体验引导：尺寸、搭配、上身效果，服务过程机器替代不了。
顾客情绪处理：投诉、退换、刁难，稳住局面靠的是人的沟通。
熟客关系经营：记住偏好、主动留客、维护复购，AI 只能提醒。
门店现场灵活应变：缺货替代方案、突发客流调度，靠临场判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的交易与流程环节正被自动化——收银、盘点、补货、推送都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为交易环节被 AI 接管，销售员被要求「更会服务、更懂体验」，面对面服务和熟客经营反而更重要。真正被挤压的是纯收银理货岗位，体验型门店和高客单品类的销售员依然抢手。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 零售适合勤工俭学和过渡就业，不建议作为长期规划。想走这行，选市场营销、零售运营专业，往店长与运营管理方向规划，别停在导购。
把销售技巧和会员数据工具用熟，主动争取带店与运营培训。从「卖货」升级为「懂数据、会带店」的店长人才，是零售里最稳的晋升线。
零售门槛低、上手快，适合过渡期和社交型人才。简历上多写「业绩达成率、复购贡献、门店活动执行」这类硬指标。
招销售别只看形象，要看服务意识和学习意愿。能适应自助收银与数据工具、又会维护熟客关系的员工，是未来门店转型的核心资产。

ai_s7_trends: 自助收银与智能补货普及，纯交易型岗位收缩，门店用工向「体验服务与运营」集中。
线上线下一体化成为标配，懂数据、会运营、能带店的复合型零售人才吃香。
体验型与新消费品牌门店扩张，面对面服务的价值被重新定价，会卖货更会留客的人更抢手。

body: 零售销售人员在零售门店从事商品推荐、顾客接待、收银结算与陈列补货工作，直接面向顾客完成销售与服务流程，是零售行业的基层主力岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你收银、理货、推优惠，但顾客站在货架前那句「您看这个适合吗」，还得人来说。
